25 | 	User     string
26 | 	Created  time.Time
27 | 	LastSeen time.Time
28 | }

30 | // Store keeps sessions in memory. Everything is lost when the process exits.
31 | type Store struct {
32 | 	mu       sync.RWMutex
33 | 	sessions map[string]Session
34 | 	ttl      time.Duration
35 | 	now      func() time.Time
36 | }
37 | 
38 | // NewStore returns an empty store. Sessions idle for longer than ttl expire.
39 | func NewStore(ttl time.Duration) *Store {
40 | 	return &Store{
41 | 		sessions: map[string]Session{},
42 | 		ttl:      ttl,
43 | 		now:      time.Now,
44 | 	}
45 | }
46 | 
47 | // Create records a new session for a user.
48 | func (s *Store) Create(id string, user string) Session {
49 | 	s.mu.Lock()
50 | 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
51 | 	at := s.now()
52 | 	session := Session{ID: id, User: user, Created: at, LastSeen: at}
53 | 	s.sessions[id] = session
54 | 	return session
55 | }
56 | 
57 | // Get returns a live session and refreshes its last-seen time. An expired
58 | // session is dropped and reported as missing.
59 | func (s *Store) Get(id string) (Session, error) {
60 | 	s.mu.Lock()
61 | 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
62 | 	session, ok := s.sessions[id]
63 | 	if !ok {
64 | 		return Session{}, ErrNotFound
65 | 	}
66 | 	if s.now().Sub(session.LastSeen) > s.ttl {
67 | 		delete(s.sessions, id)
68 | 		return Session{}, ErrNotFound
69 | 	}
70 | 	session.LastSeen = s.now()
71 | 	s.sessions[id] = session
72 | 	return session, nil
73 | }

output:
# demo

A small session service. Sessions live in memory and are lost when the process
stops.

## Run

```sh
go run .
```

- `POST /session?id=abc&user=ada` creates a session.
- `GET /session?id=abc` reads one and refreshes its last-seen time.
- `GET /healthz` reports how many sessions are held.

## Test

```sh
go test ./...
```
